system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Returns a string describing the current state of the environment. This information is injected into the agent's prompt to provide context.
system_prompt_style.note: Instructions come from YAML agent.instructions; env state injected. Default BasicEnv returns empty state, so default may be effectively templated/static.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The agent operates through a perceive–reason–act loop: it perceives environment state provided by the Environment Layer, reasons about the next steps using LLM capabilities, and selects appropriate tools to act.
env_context_strategy.note: ShellLocalEnv injects workspace path/time; BrowserEnv injects page state (opt-in).

context_compaction.evidence_quote: The Context Manager maintains a compact working context by pruning stale or redundant information while preserving essential state.
context_compaction.note: Removes obsolete HTML from prior navigation steps; default context manager behaviour not visible in evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The state represents the current content of the web page.
observation_format.note: Paper mentions screenshot tools but conversion not visible.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: ensuring compatibility with both `responses` and `chat.completions` APIs
tool_call_format.note: Built on openai-agents SDK which uses provider tool calls.

tool_count.note: Default simple/base has no toolkits per README; BasicEnv provides no tools; exact count not verifiable.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Each toolkit can be loaded in `builtin` mode (running in the main process) or `mcp` mode (running as a separate process).
tool_schema_source.note: auto_generated inferred from openai-agents function tools; not directly evidenced.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: This is configured by setting the toolkit `mode` to `mcp`.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: `SimpleAgent` implements a classic, single-agent approach based on the Reason-Act (ReAct) framework.
loop_primitives.note: Default react (SimpleAgent); OrchestraAgent plan_execute via type: orchestra.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: This paradigm is best suited for straightforward tasks that can be solved by a linear sequence of tool calls and do not require complex, long-term planning
planning_granularity.note: OrchestraAgent (opt-in) produces explicit plan of subtasks.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Load a config file where type is set to "simple" or "orchestra"

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: A single LLM is responsible for the entire task-solving process.
delegation_mechanism.note: Orchestra dispatches subtasks to worker SimpleAgents (subagent_spawn) opt-in.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: It observes the result from the tool and incorporates the new information into its context.

long_term_memory.note: Paper's Agent Practice experiences injected into context; code in separate branch at pin.

self_verification.evidence_quote: **`judge_model`**: (`ModelConfigs`) The configuration for the LLM that will act as the judge.
self_verification.note: Judge used in evaluation pipeline only, not in agent loop.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: This loop continues until the agent determines that the task is complete and generates a final answer.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: - add termination logic based on `termination_max_tokens` in `ModelConfigs`
termination_condition.note: max_turns in AgentConfig; final answer ends loop.

timeouts.note: Paper mentions tool/step/episode timeouts in RL module only.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: This is the simplest and default environment. It can be considered a "null" environment.
execution_isolation.note: Builtin toolkits run in main process; ShellLocalEnv (subprocess), BrowserEnv (container), E2B (remote) reachable.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: This is the simplest and default environment. It can be considered a "null" environment.
filesystem_access.note: ShellLocalEnv scopes to per-run workspace via prompt instruction only.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Some examples require the agent to have internet search capabilities

permission_model.evidence_quote: Each toolkit can be loaded in `builtin` mode (running in the main process) or `mcp` mode (running as a separate process).

tracing.evidence_quote: Beyond OTEL, our `DBTracingProcessor` system provides in-depth analysis of tool calls and agent trajectories.

target_domain.evidence_quote: this framework delivers powerful agent capabilities, e.g. data analysis, file processing, and deep research, all with open-source models.

open_source.note: LICENSE not in evidence; code is public on GitHub.
